title: Total jobs by local authority district
description: The number of jobs in each local authority district, from the ONS jobs density series: employee jobs, self-employment jobs, government-supported trainees and HM Forces, counted at the workplace rather than where people live. Rounded to the nearest thousand.

files.note: The NOMIS API response for dataset NM_57_1 (jobs density), item 1 (total jobs), on local authority districts as of April 2023, 2011 to 2024, saved unchanged. Re-fetch with https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/api/v01/dataset/NM_57_1.data.csv?geography=2092957697TYPE424&item=1&measures=20100&time=2011-2024&select=date_name,geography_code,geography_name,obs_value,obs_status,obs_status_name. Every period is restated on the April 2023 codes, so the series shares one code vintage. Great Britain is complete for every year; Northern Ireland's eleven districts carry values for 2020 to 2022 only, and are empty with status Q elsewhere. Nothing earlier than 2011 is published on these codes.
